description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the ApkVerifier class, specifically testing APK permission verification logic in an Android environment. It includes setup for test APKs, multiple test cases for permission matching, handling of additional and missing permissions, and permission set comparisons.

classes.name: ApkVerifierTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying APK permission handling logic in Android APKs.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, copies APK assets to writable directory.

methods.name: testNulls
methods.description: Tests permission equality function with null inputs.

methods.name: testWithMinMax
methods.description: Tests APK verification with min/max permissions based on SDK version.

methods.name: testWithPrefix
methods.description: Tests APK permission verification with a predefined set of permissions.

methods.name: testAdditionalPermission
methods.description: Verifies that additional permissions do not cause verification failure.

methods.name: testMissingPermission
methods.description: Checks that missing permissions cause verification failure.

methods.name: testExtendedPerms
methods.description: Tests verification with extended permissions, including SDK version-specific permissions.

methods.name: testImpliedPerms
methods.description: Verifies permission sets with implied permissions and SDK version considerations.
